results.summary: hkb up now reports a child that died at the 300ms recheck as `failed`, not `started`, and exits 1 when any child failed. Added the pure `deadAtRecheck` decision in model.js beside `startDecision`. While there: `down` tidies a pid file naming an already-dead process instead of leaving it (it used to say "not running" and never clean up), and a kill that throws ESRCH (process died between the liveness check and the signal) counts as stopped, not failed. Updated test/up.test.js (dead-at-recheck human + --json, ESRCH race, dead-pid-file tidy) and re-stamped docs/wiki/features/up-and-down.md. PR: https://github.com/emyann/harness-kanban-board/pull/172
